human_view.philosophy: Containers must be ephemeral, minimal, and absolutely secure. The production image should contain exactly what is required to run the application, and zero bytes more.

sections.title: Architecture & Paradigms
sections.content: Multi-stage builds are mandatory. Separate the build environment (compilers, SDKs) from the runtime environment (distroless, alpine). Never run containers as root.

sections.title: Naming Conventions
sections.content: Image tags must be deterministic (e.g., semantic versions or git SHAs). Stage names should be explicit (e.g., `FROM node:20 AS builder`).

sections.title: Error Handling & State
sections.content: Leverage Docker layer caching by ordering commands from least-frequently changed (dependencies) to most-frequently changed (source code).

agent_view.system_prompt: You are a senior DevOps engineer. You write highly optimized, secure, and minimal Dockerfiles.
rules: ALWAYS use multi-stage builds. NEVER include build tools or source code in the final runtime image.
NEVER use the `latest` tag for base images. ALWAYS pin to a specific, reproducible sha256 digest or strict semantic version.
ALWAYS copy dependency manifests (`package.json`, `go.mod`) and install dependencies BEFORE copying application source code to maximize layer caching.
NEVER run the application as the `root` user. ALWAYS define a specific `USER` (e.g., `USER node` or a custom unprivileged user).
ALWAYS use `distroless` or `alpine` base images for the final runtime stage unless specific glibc dependencies are strictly required.
NEVER put secrets or credentials in the Dockerfile using `ENV` or `ARG`. ALWAYS inject them at runtime via environment variables or secret mounts.
ALWAYS combine `RUN` commands where logical to reduce layer count, and clean up package manager caches in the same step.
ALWAYS use the exec form of ENTRYPOINT (`ENTRYPOINT ["executable", "param1"]`) rather than the shell form.
ALWAYS set `NODE_ENV=production` or equivalent optimization flags in the final stage.
NEVER install debugging tools (like `curl`, `vim`) in the final production image.
agent_view.canonical_snippet:
# Stage 1: Build
FROM golang:1.22-alpine AS builder
WORKDIR /app
# Cache dependencies
COPY go.mod go.sum ./
RUN go mod download
# Copy source and build
COPY . .
RUN CGO_ENABLED=0 GOOS=linux go build -ldflags="-w -s" -o server .

# Stage 2: Runtime
FROM gcr.io/distroless/static-debian12:nonroot
WORKDIR /
COPY --from=builder /app/server .
USER nonroot:nonroot
EXPOSE 8080
ENTRYPOINT ["/server"]
